title: file_push
description: An admin sent a file to this PC (panel **Dosya gönder**). Sent only to a connected agent that reported `files_enabled: true`, by a server that lists `file_transfer` in `server_info.features`. The agent downloads the file once from `url` on its own server with its device secret headers, checks `size` and `sha256`, writes it only to the allowlisted folder for `dest` and answers with `file_result`. It refuses `.lnk`, `.url` and `.scr` unless `allow_exec` is true. With file transfer switched off locally it answers `capability_denied` (capability `files`) or `file_result` `rejected`.

name.description: File name to write, already cleaned by the server (no path parts, no characters Windows refuses, no control or direction characters, reserved names prefixed with `_`). The agent may still refuse it.

size.description: Exact size in bytes (at most 200 MB).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lower-case hex. The download also carries it in `X-Content-SHA256`.

url.description: Path on the agent's own server (never another host): `GET` with `X-Agent-Id` and `X-Agent-Secret`. The token in `t` works once and for 1 hour; a second request, another PC, a wrong or expired token all get 404.

dest.description: Allowlisted destination: the public desktop (all users) or the agent's inbox folder.

reason.description: The admin's reason; the agent may show it and write it to its local audit trail.

allow_exec.description: The admin allowed shortcut and screen saver types (`.lnk`, `.url`, `.scr`).
